meta.title: Specimen Sorter API
meta.subject: lis-crs-spec-ack-svc — one POST to auto-register or send out from a USID
meta.author: LIS Team

slides.headline: Specimen Sorter API
slides.lede: Today staff scan a label and click Send-out or Register. The sorter will scan the tube and call LIS for those same actions.
slides.notes: Cover is identity only. TMP-000 is the dossier stand-in. Tony Chong reviewed the design note.

slides.title: Staff scans and presses today. The sorter will call LIS

left.label: As-is
left.title: Staff scans and presses
points: On Specimen Acknowledgement
One tube, one staff action

right.label: To-be
right.title: Sorter scans, LIS answers
code: sorter scans for sort and transport
LIS API for send-out or register
points: One call, then a bin
Staff screen stays as fallback

callout.text: Specimen Acknowledgement remains the fallback when the sorter returns Relabel or Failure.

slides.notes: As-is is the staff click path. To-be is the sorter calling LIS for the same send-out and registration actions. Checks and packing still sit on the screen today.

slides.title: The Spec Ack screen still owns validation and packing

rows.text: Presses Register Request. Validates. Groups tests, request no., maps ward and doctor

slides.notes: Amber is what moves. Group tests, request no., and ward/doctor mapping sit on registration, not on worksheet. Worksheet has its own convert, then print.

slides.title: One new POST on the Spec Ack service

code.caption: usid and sorterId are required. hospital may be omitted when the map has it.

findings.title: Same-call status
findings.body: REGISTERED, SEND_OUT, RELABEL, or FAILURE. Soft alerts stay off the body.

findings.title: Optional identity
findings.body: hkid and patientName. If sent and they mismatch, Failure.

findings.title: New path, not an overload
findings.body: Do not reuse the staff register call. No auth header in v1.

slides.notes: Hospital, if sent, must match the map and workbench. Unknown sorterId is Failure. Transport errors stay 500.

slides.title: Screen logic moves behind that POST

left.label: Today
left.title: On the screen
points: Worksheet convert also runs here
Then the screen calls register or print

right.label: Proposed
right.title: On the new API
points: Reuse register, worksheet print, and PHLC
Print and PHLC only after Registered

callout.text: Send-out, Relabel, and Failure print nothing. A late worksheet does not change a status already returned.

slides.notes: The next slides walk each Spec Ack action. The API calls the same print and PHLC services Spec Ack uses today, in-process, not by looping back over HTTP.

slides.title: Sorter id maps to a dedicated user and a workbench

cards.title: The map row
cards.body: Sorter id to LIS user and workbench id. Also hosp, lab, and server name so LAB_DB can open.

cards.title: The workbench row
cards.body: Hospital, lab, station name, STAR location, and default printer. Not copied as a second source of truth on the map.

cards.title: Audit user and station
cards.body: Audit user is the map user. Workstation is the workbench station name. Write SORT_* plus REG and SEND_OUT.

callout.text: Unknown sorter id is Failure. Do not compare workbench lab to the retrieved test lab.

slides.notes: Staff today pick a workbench by PC name or IP. The sorter has no PC login, so the map is the lookup. Printer stays on workbench.

slides.title: User and workbench come from the sorter id

left.label: Today
left.title: Staff login, then a PC workbench
points: User is the staff LIS login.
Workbench is selected by PC name or IP.
Staff retrieve GET uses a hard-coded demo user.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: sorterId looks up the map
points: Dedicated sorter LIS user from the map. Never the demo retrieve user.
Workbench id from the same map row, then hosp, lab, station, location, printer.
Hospital omitted: use map / workbench hosp. Hospital sent must match.

callout.text: One map row per physical sorter. Seed the user, the workbench, and the map before SIT.

slides.notes: If the workbench has no STAR location, that is Failure 4422 later in the checks. The map does not invent a location.

slides.title: Retrieve GCRS - sorter lookup is USID only

left.label: Manual
left.title: Scan or type, then retrieve
points: Staff enter specimen no., lab no., or order no.
Format, allowed hospital, and check digit run first.
Not found stops the screen (1336 / 1337 / 1338 / 1377).

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: USID, as the mapped user
points: Body needs usid and sorterId. No order-no lookup.
Same format rules. Miss is Failure. Wrong HKID or name is Failure.
In-process retrieve as the sorter user. APS / BBS / MBS is Failure.

callout.text: Hospital omitted on the POST comes from the sorter map and workbench.

slides.notes: The staff retrieve GET stays. The sorter must not call it. CPS and HMS only. DFT and STAR on those labs still retrieve.

slides.title: Send-out - the list decides, not a click

left.label: Manual
left.title: Staff press Send-out
points: Staff choose Send-out after the order is on screen.
Backend acks Printed or Collected, writes tracking, writes SEND_OUT.
A test is send-out when its cluster code is on the list for that lab and hospital.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same list. No flag from the sorter.
points: Join the test to the send-out list for lab and hospital.
All on the list: existing send-out write, status SEND_OUT.
Local plus send-out on one USID: Failure. No worksheet. No PHLC.

callout.text: The sorter does not send a send-out flag.

slides.notes: Call the list the send-out test table if asked. Mixed is Failure so the sorter does not split one tube.

slides.title: Registration checks - soft logs, hard fails

left.label: Manual
left.title: Popups on the screen
points: Soft alerts after retrieve. Staff can continue.
Hard checks before Register: mapping, datetime, test, specimen state.
Mixed local and send-out is a soft alert today.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: No dialogue
points: Soft: ALS only. Not on the body. Not Relabel.
Hard: HTTP 200 and FAILURE, code on the audit remark.
Mixed is Failure. No Relabel checkbox. STAR with no location is 4422.

callout.text: Ack time is server now. Missing collection date is soft. Do not invent a date.

slides.notes: Say the mixed change out loud. Staff can still click through that popup. The sorter cannot split the tube.

slides.title: Soft alerts - logged, then continue

cards.title: Missing collection date
cards.body: Proceed. Do not invent a date.

cards.title: Overnight specimen
cards.body: Same overnight window as Spec Ack. ALS only.

cards.title: Valid period / sex-age
cards.body: Test validity and valid-period warnings. ALS only.

slides.notes: First half of the soft set from the confirmed requirement. Next slide has the rest.

slides.title: Soft alerts - the rest of the set

cards.title: Duplicate / A-A-R
cards.body: Duplicate-reason and A-A-R-not-ready. ALS only. AAR stays off.

cards.title: Patient tag / private
cards.body: Private patient and patient-tag alerts. ALS only.

cards.title: STAR unbox alert
cards.body: Boxed warning is ALS. No workbench location is Failure 4422, not this card.

callout.text: BBS blood / category / T&S alerts stay on staff Spec Ack. BBS is out of v1.

slides.notes: Mixed is not here. The locked design made mixed a hard Failure.

slides.title: Hard checks that return Failure

cards.title: Unmapped ward / doctor
cards.body: Doctor, location, specialty, report dest, or report copy has no LIS id.

cards.title: Datetime
cards.body: Collection before DOB. Ack before collection or request. Ack in the future.

cards.title: STAR / mixed / empty
cards.body: No workbench location. Local plus send-out. Already used, all registered, all deleted, rejected.

callout.text: Also Failure: missing test dictionary, HKID or name mismatch, APS / BBS / MBS, unknown sorter id.

slides.notes: Do not auto-create an unmapped doctor or location. Soft set on the previous two slides is not Failure.

slides.title: Request test grouping and request no.

left.label: Manual
left.title: Screen groups, then assigns
points: Tests are grouped before Register. Each group needs a request no.
USID can be the request no. when the screen says it is eligible.
Staff can tick Relabel. Multi-group, multi-specimen, suffix not 0, or force: no USID.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same grouping. No checkbox.
points: Same Relabel rules, without a user tick.
One group, one specimen, suffix 0, not force: request no. = USID.
Else Relabel. No lab request. No invented number. No caller-assigned request no.

callout.text: Relabel is its own status. Not Failure. Not Registered.

slides.notes: Partial DFT remainder is Relabel. DFT still uses Spec Ack register, not the DFT register API.

slides.title: Ward and doctor mapping

left.label: Manual
left.title: Map, then popup
points: Doctor, location, specialty, report dest, and report copy come from dictionary.
Unmapped codes block Register.
Staff can create a doctor when dictionary allows it.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same map. No create.
points: Same five mappings go onto the packed register call.
Any miss is Failure, same message codes as Spec Ack.
Do not auto-create a doctor or location. Send the tube to staff.

callout.text: Do not compare workbench lab to the order test lab.

slides.notes: Report destination can follow request location when that Spec Ack option is on. Port the existing rule. Do not invent a new one.

slides.title: Worksheet printing - all after Registered

left.label: Manual
left.title: Staff print after Register
points: Staff can print GCRS, send-out, and SH worksheets after register.
If more than one worksheet, staff pick.
Labels can also print on the staff path.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Print all, after the HTTP return
points: Return REGISTERED first. Then print every worksheet Spec Ack would. No picker.
Send-out, Relabel, and Failure print nothing. No labels.
Late worksheet is allowed. Print fail is ALS. Status stays Registered.

callout.text: p95 under 4 seconds is retrieve plus send-out or register. Print is off that clock.

slides.notes: Same three staff print services, in-process, no HTTP loopback. Registration only.

slides.title: PHLC electronic order - after Registered

left.label: Manual
left.title: Screen calls PHLC after register
points: Spec Ack creates a PHLC order when the lab option is on.
Destination must match the existing PHLC rule.
Staff wait on the screen for that call.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same create. Sorter does not wait.
points: Same PHLC create, in-process, after REGISTERED is already back.
Only when Spec Ack would send. Send-out, Relabel, and Failure skip it.
PHLC fail is ALS. Sorter status stays Registered.

callout.text: No labels on the sorter path. Worksheet and PHLC never run on Send-out.

slides.notes: PHLC is already backend. The change is when it runs. Do not invent a new PHLC contract.

slides.title: Seed user, workbench, and map, then deploy

cards.title: Create the sorter user
cards.body: Dedicated LIS user on the audit trail. Not a shared staff login.

cards.title: Seed a workbench row
cards.body: One row per sorter: hosp, lab, station name, location, printer.

cards.title: Insert the map row
cards.body: Sorter id, user, and workbench id on loe_specimen_sorter_map.

cards.title: Deploy and open the path
cards.body: Deploy lis-crs-spec-ack-svc. NetworkPolicy only. No API key in v1.

slides.notes: Pilot CPS and HMS. Relabel and Failure bins go back to staff Spec Ack. Add SORT_* to the Audit Trail filter.

slides.title: Stop middleware. Staff Spec Ack is unchanged

cards.title: Stop middleware
cards.body: Staff clicks still retrieve, send-out, and register.

cards.title: Drop the map table
cards.body: DROP TABLE loe_specimen_sorter_map on full rollback. Leave or disable the workbench and user.

cards.title: No history rewrite
cards.body: Do not convert historical requests. Fallback is operational.

slides.notes: The staff path is the fallback. Drop only the map table.

slides.title: Four decisions to ratify before build

asks.q: Leave v1 with NetworkPolicy only, no API key or Hub JWT?
asks.why: Same isolation as Spec Ack today (D1).

asks.q: Fail the tube when the USID has both local and send-out tests?
Print worksheets and PHLC only after Registered, after HTTP return?
Show SORT_* actions on the Audit Trail filter?

callout.text: Requester already answered D1-D11. This room ratifies.

slides.notes: Requester already answered D1-D11. This room is the ratification, not a new design pass.

slides.headline: Q&A
slides.notes: Likely questions: why a new POST; why hospital can be omitted; why DFT uses the same register path.

slides.headline: Target latency
slides.note: About 20 specimens a minute per lab in v1. Worksheet and PHLC sit after the sorter wait path.

nextSteps.title: Implement the POST
nextSteps.body: New API on lis-crs-spec-ack-svc, including the packing the screen does today.

nextSteps.title: Seed SIT
nextSteps.body: Sorter user, workbench row, and loe_specimen_sorter_map before middleware is pointed at SIT.

slides.notes: Volume pass mark is about 20 specimens a minute per lab. Print sits after the sorter wait path.
